case: CASE result with empty TEXT refuses lossy XLSX export and preserves destination
contract: The CASE result retains fallback metadata and native typeof() confirms INTEGER, branch TEXT, SQL NULL, BLOB, tag-prefix TEXT and empty TEXT per row.
The CSV export/import path restores all named runtime storage classes, including empty TEXT separately from SQL NULL, into STRICT ANY with native value checks.
The XLSX writer refuses empty TEXT at data row 6, result column 2 because a blank workbook cell would be ambiguous, and preserves the pre-existing destination bytes without leaving a temporary file.
This proves the named CASE-to-CSV-to-native-import path and fail-closed XLSX refusal; spreadsheet-application re-import and other computed-expression consumers remain open.
